theme: An open day, with an early start waiting on tomorrow.
greeting: Nothing sits on today's calendar, Dan - the day is yours. The quiet ends early tomorrow, though, with back-to-back morning calls, so a little prep tonight sets the morning up.

needsAttention.title: Prep the ICGN Toronto planning call
needsAttention.detail: Claudia Rossetti sent the Plenary 7 session outline to review before tomorrow's 7:30 AM call on evolving stewardship data and reporting - skim it tonight so you arrive ready to shape the panel.

needsAttention.title: Get the Valoris agenda from Mike
needsAttention.detail: Mike added a 10:15 AM call with you, Martin and Davit but attached no agenda - a quick line asking what it covers means you walk in oriented.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: This has sat at top priority since mid-September; a full-size SUV out of Portland sells out over the holidays, and a refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Both the decide-by and book-by dates have passed, and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year - pick the domestic-or-international path and commit.

flagged.title: Hans-Kristian Bryn checked in
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn note three days ago asking how the transition is going - a warm networking thread worth a reply.

flagged.title: KPMG US Managing Director alert
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn job alert for a KPMG US Managing Director role came through today.

flagged.title: NACD New England run of show
flagged.detail: The run of show for next week's Oct 28 NACD event circulated - flag anything that needs editing.
